name: finsec-mcp
title: Calera FINSEC — Certified SEC Memory
description: Certified SEC EDGAR fact memory for AI agents with zero confabulation and cryptographic filing provenance across 10-K and 10-Q disclosures.

tools.name: query_financial_sec
tools.description: Certified SEC fact query against official SEC EDGAR disclosures (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) powered by Calera Episteme-1. Returns verified numerical values with cryptographic filing provenance or an honest SAFE_REFUSAL. Does not guess or hallucinate numbers. Use this tool for natural-language financial questions, revenue, net income, cash flow, margins, and historical company metrics. Monetary answers default to the filer's reporting currency (use target_currency or append 'in USD' for audited FX conversion). Treat SAFE_REFUSAL as a success-of-honesty, indicating the metric was not disclosed in official SEC filings.

query.description: Natural language financial question (e.g. 'What was Apple's FY2023 revenue?', 'Microsoft R&D expenses in 2022'). Append 'in USD' to convert reporting currency.

target_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP) for post-recall FX conversion using audited annual-average rates.

usd_only.description: When true, forces monetary answers into USD.

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema optimized for high-QPS agent swarms.

hash.description: Cryptographic audit hash verifying SEC EDGAR filing provenance

tools.name: valuation_inputs
tools.description: Retrieves certified SEC/EDGAR valuation inputs packs (12 packs including dcf_valuation_inputs, dupont_5step, altman_z_prime, benish_m_score, piotroski_f_score, working_capital, debt_coverage, roic_wacc_inputs). Use this tool when performing structured valuation modeling, financial distress scoring, or fundamental earnings quality analysis. Returns verified historical line items and balance sheet components. Do NOT use for real-time market stock prices, enterprise value (EV), or forward-looking trading estimates.

company.description: Company ticker or name, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, MSFT, NVDA

period.description: Optional reporting period, e.g. 'FY2023', 'Q3 FY2023'. Defaults to latest audited fiscal year if omitted.

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

cells.description: Certified pack cells dictionary containing filing values and accession metadata

tools.name: query_sec_metric_exact
tools.description: Exact single-cell SEC EDGAR metric recall for a specified company ticker, fiscal period, and financial concept. Server-side verified fact with complete accession and filing provenance. Use this tool when querying precise accounting items (e.g. Total Revenue, Net Income, Operating Cash Flow, R&D Expenses) for a specific fiscal year or quarter. Returns SAFE_REFUSAL if the exact concept is not declared in the filer's XBRL taxonomy.

company.description: Company ticker or legal name, e.g. AAPL

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

tools.name: compute_sec_cagr
tools.description: Calculates the exact Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) over certified SEC filing facts. Executes deterministic mathematical computation with 0.00% statistical hallucination. Use this tool when evaluating multi-year growth rates for revenue, net income, operating cash flow, or EPS across fiscal periods. Returns the exact float CAGR, formatted percentage string, and underlying filing operands with provenance.

company.description: Company ticker or name, e.g. AAPL

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

operands.description: Metric values used in calculation with accession provenance

tools.name: lattice_arith_evaluate
tools.description: Deterministic zero-error algebraic solver over verified SEC EDGAR metrics supporting operations: 'cagr', 'ratio', 'multiply', 'divide', 'yoy_series', 'product_chain', and 'margin'. Use this tool when computing mathematical combinations of SEC filing metrics (e.g. gross margin, debt-to-equity ratio, year-over-year revenue series) where algebraic precision is mandatory and language model arithmetic confabulation is unacceptable.

op.description: Operation to perform (cagr | ratio | multiply | divide | yoy_series | product_chain | margin)

company.description: Ticker or legal entity when resolving EDGAR cells

periods.description: Optional comma-separated fiscal periods for series (e.g. 'FY2021,FY2022,FY2023')

factors.description: Optional comma-separated positive factors for product_chain

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

tools.name: vln_capabilities_overview
tools.description: Dynamic scope overview and capability boundaries for the Volumetric Lattice Network financial engine. Returns verified coverage matrices, supported valuation packs, available algebraic operators, taxonomy concept aliases, and API quota policies. Use this tool to discover supported analytical packs and verify system boundaries before executing multi-step analysis.

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

certified_valuation_packs.description: List of available structured valuation packs

tools.name: query_sec_sector_peers
tools.description: Queries multi-company sector and industry financial comparisons declared in SEC filings. Returns standardized fundamental metrics across peer companies within a specified sector (e.g. semiconductors, enterprise software, retail banking, aerospace). Use this tool for relative fundamental analysis, cross-company benchmarking, and sector baseline metric comparisons.

sector_or_industry.description: Industry or sector description as declared in SEC filings (e.g. 'semiconductors', 'optics', 'cloud_software')

low_tokens.description: Optional. When true, returns compact JSON schema.

peers.description: List of peer company metrics with filing accessions
